title: gh pr view N --json state,title,url,mergedAt,mergeCommit: the pull request octo-feather-lane veto reads (issue-lifecycle spec #gates-digest)
description: Validated by scripts/merge_digest.py (veto) before it trusts the answer; gh prints exactly the fields asked, so no other key is allowed. A PR not merged has mergedAt and mergeCommit null.

state.description: GitHub's state of the pull request

mergedAt.description: When it merged, UTC, as GitHub gives it; null when not merged

mergeCommit.description: Its merge commit; null when not merged
